newsitem.title: UK: Air cargo forum eyes China for 2002 meeting.
newsitem.headline: Air cargo forum eyes China for 2002 meeting.

text.p: The International Air Cargo Association (TIACA) has launched a membership recruitment drive in Asia and would like to see China host its 2002 biennial world forum, said chairman and president Chris Foyle.

He told Reuters in an interview that while TIACA was formed as primarily a U.S. organisation in 1988, it was now steadily increasing its membership worldwide and was particularly badly unrepresented in Asia.
"After Paris in May 1998 and the U.S.(Los Angeles, Miami or Washington DC) in 2000, I would like to see TIACA's biennial, 21st International Air Cargo Forum and Exposition held in Asia," he stated.
"Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Hong Kong and Tokyo are obvious candidates, although I would like to see it held in China," he said.
Foyle added that Taiwan's China Airlines was at present TIACA's only Asia carrier member
Foyle, who is chairman of Air Foyle, will be succeeded as TIACA chairman and president at its annual general meeting in London from December 4-5 by Gunther Rohrmann, president of AEI .
